artifact.transcript:
AI: Thanks for calling Cavern Electrical. You've reached our after-hours line. I'm an automated assistant and this call is recorded so the team can follow up. What's going on tonight?
User: Hi, my basement is flooding from the snow melt and the water is getting close to the electrical panel.
AI: Please don't go into the water or touch the panel. If you can't stay safe, leave the house and call 911. Is anyone in the basement now?
User: No, we're all upstairs.
AI: Good. What's your name?
User: Lena Brandt.
AI: And a number where the electrician can reach you?
User: This number is fine. 612-555-0159.
AI: What's the address?
User: It's 31 Quarry Ridge Drive.
AI: Thank you, Lena. I've marked this as an emergency and the on-call electrician will call you right back.
